issue_context.title: [API Proposal]: Safe API for covariant cast of ReadOnlySpan<T>
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-memory See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
### Background and motivation It is always safe to convert a `ReadOnlySpan` to a `ReadOnlySpan` when `U` inherits from `T` (and neither are value types). However, performing such a cast is remarkably ugly and requires unsafe APIs: ```cs public static ReadOnlySpan
CC. @stephentoub, @GrabYourPitchforks for a second glance. This seems like a fine API with prior art, so I'd lean towards marking it `ready-for-review` and taking it to API review

review_comments: Please add XML doc comments describing the method. They'll be used to seed the docs.

I like this better than the `ImmutableArray` version, which is
> Initializes a new instance of the [ImmutableArray<T>](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.collections.immutable.immutablearray-1?view=net-8.0) struct based on the contents of an existing instance, allowing a covariant static cast to efficiently reuse the existing array.

and for `TDerived`
> The type of array element to return.

I'd suggest moving the second phrase to be a sentence in remarks (e.g. "This enables covariant cast. Because of the relationships between the types expressed in the type constraints, it is a safe operation that produces a span pointing to the same memory as the original.", or something like that).  But otherwise, lgtm.
